s1.sub: Whatever stopped you, ClutchD gets you moving — verified mechanics, transparent estimates, 24/7 roadside response.

image.alt: Cinematic wide shot of an empty asphalt two-lane desert highway stretching into total pitch black darkness at 2am

s1.promise: Breakdowns do not check the clock. ClutchD pairs one-tap SOS dispatch with live tracking, upfront estimates, and digital service history, so a dead battery or a flat tyre becomes a handled job, not a long night.

trust.body: Every provider passes identity and skill checks. You see their rating before they reach you.
The estimate lands first. You approve it, then the wrench lifts. No surprises on the invoice.
Watch arrival live on the map, chat in-app, and keep the finished job in your vehicle's history.

s1.sosBody: One tap broadcasts your location to verified nearby mechanics. Watch the match happen live, track arrival on the map, and message your mechanic in-app. No call centers, no hold music.

s2.sub: Find verified mechanics, request roadside help, source the right parts, track work live, and keep your complete service history.

pillars.body: Every mechanic and garage passes identity and skill checks (KYC) before joining the network. No anonymous strangers at your breakdown.
See the price before the work starts. You approve the estimate, then the wrench lifts. Labour and parts are shown separately.
Pay through the platform with Stripe and Razorpay. Every payment is protected and receipt-backed.

commitments.body: Identity and skill verification before anyone joins the network.
See the price before work starts. Approve it, then work begins.
Real feedback from real jobs keeps the network honest.
Stripe and Razorpay. Protected and receipt-backed, every time.
History lives on the vehicle, not in a drawer of paper invoices.

s2.commitmentsTitle: TRUST — know exactly who you are dealing with
s2.commitmentsSub: Five commitments that make automotive care something you can rely on.

marketplace.fitmentTitle: Only parts that fit your vehicle
marketplace.fitmentBody: Pick your make, model, and year, and only see parts that actually fit your vehicle. No guessing, no wrong-order roulette.
marketplace.compareBody: Compare prices across verified suppliers before you order. No more phoning around for quotes.

headline: Five Steps.
Start to Finish.
s3.sub: From request to completed service: ClutchD matches you with verified nearby providers in minutes — you approve the estimate before the wrench lifts, and track every step live.

steps.title: REQUEST
steps.body: Tap SOS or pick a calibrated service profile; outline mechanical malfunction indicators.

steps.title: MATCH
steps.body: Algorithmic proximity dispatch connects localized certified specialists by diagnostic tier.

steps.title: TRACK
steps.body: Watch arrival in sub-second telemetry mapping; continuous bidirectional audio/data link.

steps.title: FIXED
steps.body: Standardized roadside interventions with photographic diagnostic audit checkpoints.

steps.title: REVIEW
steps.body: One-tap automated ledger settlement, parts warranty logging, and technician evaluation.

s3.plainBody: Your vehicle stops. You tell us where you are and what happened. We find a verified mechanic nearby. You watch them arrive, approve the price before work starts, then pay and rate. The job joins your vehicle's history on its own.
s3.targetsNote: These are engineering targets we calibrate during the Coimbatore pilot, not promised arrival times. Traffic, distance, and part availability change every job.
stepTargets: Design target: raise a request in about a minute, location included.
Design target: match with a verified nearby provider in minutes.
Design target: a live ETA you can watch on the map.
Design target: an estimate you approve before work begins.
Design target: pay, rate, and save the record in one tap.
s3.cancelBody: You can cancel a request before a mechanic accepts, and every cancelled dispatch stays visible in your history. If a match fails, request again and the system re-searches nearby providers.

headline: Where We're
Headed.

rows.body: Verified mechanics, roadside help, parts, payments and service history — one ecosystem, live in Coimbatore.
rows.sub: LIVE DISPATCH, GPS TRACKING & PARTS MARKETPLACE

rows.body: Warranty protection on every part you buy, deeper vehicle diagnostics, and full fleet contracts for commercial operations.
Statewide expansion across Tamil Nadu, driver subscription perks, and multi-language roadside triage.

s7.expansionBody: ClutchD is live in Coimbatore, our proving ground. Every dispatch, estimate, and review here teaches the system before it opens in the next city. Statewide coverage across Tamil Nadu is the horizon; interstate corridors come after.
details: Phase one, already live: roadside dispatch with live GPS tracking, upfront estimates, Stripe and Razorpay payments, the parts marketplace, and digital service history.
In development now: warranty claims on marketplace parts, deeper vehicle diagnostics, and fleet contracts for commercial operations.
On the horizon: Tamil Nadu statewide expansion, driver subscription perks, and multi-language roadside triage. No dates promised; each phase opens when the pilot proves it.
s7.honesty: We do not announce dates we cannot keep. Each phase opens when the current one proves itself in Coimbatore.

s8.sub: Dispatch telemetry pairs to your coordinate the moment you request help. No call centers, no hold music — engineered for minutes, not hours.
steps: Open the web app in your browser and add it to your home screen. It installs as a PWA and works like a native app.
Android users can also install the ClutchD APK directly (package com.clutchd.app) once the public download is published.
Sign in, add your vehicle, and you are ready to raise an SOS or browse parts.
s8.reqBody: A modern Android phone or any phone with a web browser. The PWA needs no store download; the Android APK installs directly. An internet connection is required for live dispatch and tracking.
includes: Live GPS tracking and in-app chat
